subject: Clarify token re‑attribution and VAT reverse‑charge for Q1 mid‑cycle invoice
messages:
From: Alan Park <alan@rightscale.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: RightScale Finance <finance@rightscale.com>
Date: 2025-02-11T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected mid‑cycle charges + VAT applied — request for itemized usage

Hi Jonas,

We received an interim invoice dated 2025‑02‑10 showing ~2.3M tokens consumed and VAT applied at 20%. Our internal team is confident a sizable portion of that traffic was test/sandbox jobs from a project we keep separated (project id: rs-sandbox-01) and should be excluded or re‑attributed.

Can you provide: an itemized usage export (by project/credential), raw session ids for the 2025‑02‑10 window, and whether VAT was applied because the billing entity on your side lacks reverse‑charge accounting? If reverse‑charge applies we need an updated invoice without VAT and the corresponding documentation.

We are mid‑quarter and this will impact our cash flow forecast — would appreciate a quick triage.

Thanks,
Alan Park
Director, Finance — RightScale
[Attachment: RightScale_invoice_20250210.pdf]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Park <alan@rightscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-02-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid‑cycle charges + VAT applied — request for itemized usage

Hi Alan — thanks for flagging this. Sorry for the surprise. I've looped in Marissa from billing and Aditya from infra.

Immediate plan:
- Aditya: run a scoped query for the 2025‑02‑10 window and produce an itemized CSV by project/credential and session id.
- Marissa: hold the invoice in our system pending triage and prepare a draft credit memo template if there is double‑counting.
- Jonas: coordinate VAT reverse‑charge questions with legal/billing — Alan, could you confirm RightScale's VAT registration number and whether you are the importer of record? That helps speed reversal if applicable.

I’ll send a short interim update later today.

—Jonas
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: —]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Park <alan@rightscale.com>
Date: 2025-02-12T07:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid‑cycle charges + VAT applied — request for itemized usage

Alan/Jonas/Marissa — quick technical summary of what I found after an initial pass of telemetry:

- Root cause candidate: 2025‑02‑12 02:00–08:00 UTC we had a regional ingestion failover to standby processing (short network partition). During the failover a subset of sessions were replayed by the router and the ingest pipeline accepted duplicates for about a 6‑hour window.
- Impact: ~1.0–1.2M tokens were duplicated and attributed to the active project credential instead of the original sandbox credential in some cases where session hashes were regenerated.
- Evidence attached: 
  * ingest-failure-sample-logs.txt (sample 50 lines with repeated request ids and timestamps)
  * usage-export-2025-02-01_2025-02-10.csv (scoped rows flagged with a duplicate_flag column)

Next steps I recommend:
1) We create a re‑attribution mapping to move duplicated rows back to their originating project where deterministically possible (matching original session id + user agent + IP / 95% match).
2) For rows that can’t be deterministically re‑attributed we propose a compensation credit (pro‑rata) and mark those records as duplicated in the audit file.

I’ll hand the detailed CSV to Marissa for billing adjustments. Happy to jump on a short call to walk the logs.

—Aditya
Principal SRE, Inference Runtime
[Attachment: ingest-failure-sample-logs.txt, usage-export-2025-02-01_2025-02-10.csv]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Park <alan@rightscale.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-02-13T11:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid‑cycle charges + VAT applied — request for itemized usage

Hi Alan — thanks for your patience and thanks Aditya for the analysis. Summary of the proposed commercial remediation: 

1) Re‑attribution & credit: We will re‑attribute ~900k tokens that we can deterministically match back to rs‑sandbox‑01 and issue a credit for those tokens on the next invoice. For ~300k tokens where attribution is ambiguous we propose a pro‑rata credit; total proposed credit = 1.2M tokens (~$960).

2) VAT handling: If RightScale is able to supply a valid EU VAT registration number (and confirm you are the reverse‑charge recipient) we will reissue the affected invoice lines without VAT and provide a credit memo showing VAT reversal. Please send the VAT ID and the legal name exactly as registered.

3) Timing & deliverables:
- Today (EOD): final CSV with re‑attribution flags and a small sample of matched session ids.
- 2025‑02‑17: draft credit memo (RTS‑CRED‑2025‑02) and updated invoice (no VAT) if we receive VAT documentation.
- Marissa will confirm once the credit posts.

Please confirm you accept this remediation path or propose an alternative. We’re also open to issuing an immediate interim unapplied credit if you prefer faster cashflow relief while we finalize matching.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: draft-credit-memo-RTS-2025-02.pdf]

From: Alan Park <alan@rightscale.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, RightScale Finance <finance@rightscale.com>
Date: 2025-02-14T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid‑cycle charges + VAT applied — request for itemized usage

Marissa/Jonas/Aditya — thank you. That approach works for us. VAT ID: GB999888777. Legal name: RightScale Ltd.

We accept the re‑attribution + pro‑rata credit and request the interim unapplied credit while the final invoice is reissued — helps our month close. Please also include the list of re‑attributed session ids so our auditors can reconcile.

As a final ask: can you confirm whether Redwood will self‑report the VAT adjustment or whether we (RightScale) need to account for it under our reverse‑charge process? Final documentation on the invoice/credit memo should make this explicit.

Best,
Alan Park
Director, Finance — RightScale
[Attachment: VAT_registration_GB999888777.pdf]
